title: Devanagari ↔ Latin mapping scheme (ISO 15919 / IAST–conformant, normalized)
context: Devanagari is the second script pair, chosen because it exercises the engine's conjunct/virama handling and the normalized reversibility class (round-trips losslessly up to a documented normalization contract). ISO 15919 and IAST are scholarly conventions, not copyrighted tables; the mapping is built from open/PD sources and re-derived. A license/provenance check analogous to license-000 must be performed before authoring. This is the first scheme in the Devanagari family, so a second independent reviewer is mandatory.
objective: Author data/schemes/deva-latn-iso15919.yaml — a validated Devanagari ↔ Latin scheme tagged reversibility: normalized, with a documented normalization contract, a loss report, virama/conjunct handling, and all Devanagari-specific edge cases covered. Built from open/PD sources; provenance recorded. Qualified Devanagari reviewer + mandatory second reviewer sign-off.
acceptanceCriteria: License/provenance prerequisite confirmed in writing before authoring: Devanagari scheme can be built from open/PD sources without copying any copyrighted table; output licenses compatible

data/schemes/deva-latn-iso15919.yaml validates against mappingSchemeSchema; tagged reversibility: normalized, normalizationForm: NFC, with a documented normalizationContract field and a non-null lossReport
Engine handles Devanagari grapheme clusters: virama/conjunct sequences, anusvara, visarga, nukta, and documented schwa handling; Devanagari digits (U+0966–U+096F: ०१२३) tested explicitly
Round-trip asserts equality up to the declared normalization contract (not byte-identity) on golden vectors + property-generated cases + open Devanagari corpus; green in CI
conformsTo cites ISO 15919 and/or IAST convention without copying any copyrighted table; provenanceRefs resolve to open/PD allow-listed sources
UNCERTAIN: flags from the drafting agent captured into data/review/deva-latn-iso15919.yaml; no sign-off while any flag is unresolved
Qualified Devanagari reviewer sign-off AND a second independent qualified reviewer sign-off recorded in the PR (mandatory: first scheme in Devanagari family)
resources: PLAN.md — scheme-deva-001 M1 acceptance criteria; hard-case test inventory
